t: You're looking at the bronze statue of Margaret Thatcher, which stands in the Members' Lobby of the Houses of Parliament. It was sculpted by Antony Dufort and unveiled on 21 February 2007 by the Speaker, Michael Martin, with Thatcher present. It was commissioned in 2003, after a rule change allowed living prime ministers to be depicted in Parliament. Thatcher was the first woman to be Prime Minister, serving from 1979 to 1990, and the longest-serving prime minister of the twentieth century.
